blocks.text: Exclusive gazebo and pergola design with completed project

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed the design of an exclusive gazebo with a pergola, combining contemporary aesthetics, functionality, and comfort.

The project included detailed development of the architectural concept, proportions, exterior appearance, combinations of finishing materials, outdoor lounge area, and decorative lighting. Particular attention was paid to creating a design that harmoniously complements the architecture of the private house and its surrounding outdoor space.

The gazebo was designed as a comfortable area for relaxation and entertaining guests, with convenient seating and carefully planned lighting for evening use. High-quality materials suitable for outdoor applications and resistant to changing weather conditions were specified for the project.
Photorealistic 3D visualizations were created to clearly present the proposed architecture, materials, details, and overall appearance before construction.

The gazebo with pergola was built according to the project developed by DUMSKAYA DESIGN. This page presents both the original 3D visualizations and photographs of the completed structure, showing how the architectural concept was brought to life.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) — we create interiors and exteriors that come to life.
